method: Read RULES.md and TAXONOMY.md; verified sample hashes; ran atomscan and cleave facts; used Rizin, Capstone, dnfile/dncil and bounded Unicorn emulation. No sample ran under the host OS; no C2 was contacted. Emulation supplies explicit synthetic API/helper results, so it proves recovered strings and selected data flow, not Windows runtime success.

samples.identification: Mason-wrapped native dropper, VB.NET self-installing encrypted-resource loader, and obfuscated managed-to-native activation stage; njRAT family not established by filename
samples.marker_line: Mason .NET loader: UAC bypass, Defender exclusions; retain traits
evidence: Carved managed PEs from original offsets 0x166134 (44032 bytes) and 0x170d34 (967168 bytes). Independently dumped IL for the latter.

Entry method RVA 0x21a8 checks administrator membership. The non-admin branch writes a CMSTP INF, runs cmstp /au and posts Enter to its window. INF pre-setup commands launch mshta/vbscript/WScript.Shell, then cmd /c start, and terminate CMSTP.

Admin path starts hidden PowerShell Add-MpPreference commands for path and process exclusions. It copies itself under AppData as taskhostw.exe, sets Hidden+System attributes, registers a hidden repeating one-minute task and launches a temporary batch to delete its original and itself.

Resource 6&6.Resources / dsadwdsawadada passes through RijndaelManaged ECB decryption keyed by MD5 of 6;646&6ax&xx;;;9x. Independently recovered a 772096-byte managed PE with valid PKCS7 padding; late-bound Assembly.Load feeds EntryPoint.Invoke.

Recovered stage Main at RVA 0x2b1fc calls VirtualAlloc, copies reconstructed bytes and calls CreateThread followed by WaitForSingleObject. The FieldRVA buffer at RVA 0x2050 is 81995 bytes; XOR 0x9b recovers a native call-based stage. Final RAT behavior remains unresolved.
samples.judgment: Elevation bypass, covert durable installation, Defender exclusions and concealed payload activation establish hostile intent; ordinary installer behavior does not explain the combination. No authorized deployment context was supplied. Existing 3 hostile and 2 suspicious child detections are supported and retained.

samples.identification: Obfuscated x64 native DLL with Rust runtime patterns, environmental gates, encrypted strings and a covert host-report HTTP path; family unresolved
samples.marker_line: Obfuscated Rust implant: covert host POST; fix false timestomp
evidence: The provided decoded artifact uses mapped-image bytes with disk section offsets in its headers. Its import directory at physical offset/RVA 0x8ea48 is valid when interpreted as mapped bytes; a temporary analysis-only view recovers 110 imports. The original remains unchanged. The artifact is truncated relative to SizeOfImage; static TLS constants required by selected paths were inferred from code constraints and validated by coherent decoded strings.

Mapped entry RVA 0x79120 reaches CRT startup, then the DLL entry at 0x1000 -> 0xd410. DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH creates a thread through 0x4f36f / CreateThread. The thread wrapper invokes the user worker at 0x5dfc3 after Rust spawn hooks.

Recovered the pure string decoder at RVA 0x482be: a shuffled five-bit alphabet, byte reconstruction, PRNG-keyed XOR and bitstream reconstruction. Bounded decoder emulation recovers valid API/configuration strings independently of atomscan.

The worker queries CPUID leaf 0x40000000 and compares recovered VM vendor strings including Linux KVM Hv, XenVMMXenVMM, Parallels and HAXM. It resolves GetSystemFirmwareTable for RSMB, collects environment information, checks display indicators and constructs CIS locale exclusions (tk, uz, kk, ru, hy, az, uk, be, tg, ky, ro-md).

Environment collector RVA 0x41e6c contains the locale, memory, display and username query paths. Its output flows through serialization at 0x258bd and transformation at 0x897f into the body arguments of HTTP helper 0x234ef from call site 0x5fc5e. The recovered destination is verrogantiff.com, path /, method POST. WinHTTP loading is confirmed by recovered winhttp.dll and WinHttpOpen. Emulation explicitly substitutes an empty environment report and transformation result to trace the call; the source-to-body linkage is established by the disassembly and shared argument values, not by claiming genuine captured data was transmitted.
A recovered embedded message tells automated analysts that reverse engineering violates an AI provider policy and asks them to reject analysis. This is untrusted sample content and was ignored.

The sole SetFileTime call at mapped RVA 0x5ab73 follows CreateFileW and passes NULL creation time plus -1 access/write times: it suppresses timestamp updates for a handle; no historical timestamp replacement is established. The only IsDebuggerPresent call at 0x7017f sits in CRT exception reporting beside RtlCaptureContext, RtlVirtualUnwind and UnhandledExceptionFilter. VirtualProtect calls around 0x727b1 manage runtime data permissions, not an established code-unpacking action.
samples.judgment: Automatic concealed host reporting to an unrelated endpoint, anti-VM execution gates and CIS locale exclusion configuration and deliberate analyst manipulation support likely malicious spying/C2 use. No legitimate product purpose, consenting deployment or authorized management context was supplied. A final stealing/tasking payload and successful runtime transmission are not claimed.
samples.coverage_gap: Three suspicious findings remain (DLL/extension mismatch, TLS dispatch flattening, concealed PRNG/API-reference profile), including two distinct supported concealment behaviors. The encrypted host-report API/configuration path is documented from reverse engineering; no hash, chosen domain, ciphertext fingerprint or duplicate hostile trait was added to manufacture coverage. Calibrated ML still misses the artifact.

samples.identification: Tofsee bot/spambot with rolling-XOR configuration and process image replacement
samples.marker_line: Tofsee bot: Defender exclusion and suspended-process replacement
evidence: Rizin confirms the decoder at VA 0x402544 copies each byte XORed with a changing key; key starts at E4 and advances by C8 plus alternating +1/-1.

Independently decoded VA 0x410710 to SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Exclusions\Paths. Code at 0x4083c0 binds this decoder output to HKLM RegOpenKeyExA; RegQueryValueExA checks the current DWORD and RegSetValueExA at 0x408441 writes zero for the selected path exclusion.

The same decoder recovers the Run key, Policies\System, ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin and PromptOnSecureDesktop; code reads those settings. Their presence is not overstated as a demonstrated UAC-policy write.

VA 0x40977c creates a process with CREATE_SUSPENDED (4), gets its thread context, prepares a replacement image, writes its base address through the PEB address derived from EBX+8, changes the entry register, sets thread context and resumes the thread. The failure path terminates the child. Some helper bytes are damaged; no claim of successful execution is made.

The bot-state schema loader_id/hi_id/born_date/net_type, rolling decoder, SMTP from/to/original-message templates and delivery counters support Tofsee identity in addition to the third-party signatures. A large raw relocation section supplies filler, not extra executable code.
samples.judgment: Concealed security exclusions combined with suspended-process image replacement establish malicious evasion and execution; bulk-email content alone was not used to convict. Existing hostile exclusion/hollowing and Tofsee SMTP/configuration detections remain supported; no edit is needed.

removed_unsupported_claim.reason: No parsed imports plus API names and checksum zero do not establish import concealment, a debugger gate, code-protection modification or timestomping. The reviewed positive is a damaged mapped artifact with ordinary runtime call paths. All capability/structure atoms remain. No suppression or filename exception was added.
removed_unsupported_claim.consumer_audit: No YAML consumer references this composite. Its introduction commit 989bf9eaaa identifies this same decoded artifact as its positive. Other timestamp composites are unchanged. Historical DvnX sample cefd574917e8 was identified for additional retained coverage; a forager hash fetch returned no artifact, so no nonexistent positive test is claimed.

The symmetric transform belongs in encoding/xor, without an unsupported direction. Its sole YAML consumer is updated and now accepts an imported or textual GetProcAddress reference while continuing to require the loop and TLS flattening. The description no longer claims export walking or a bound decode-to-resolution flow.
rule_changes.reference_audit: Audited exact consumers and directory selectors for all ancestors of old/new XOR locations: no broad ancestor selectors are present. No other YAML references the renamed API profile. Historical review JSON remains a dated record, not an active consumer.

detection_losses: Only the unsupported importless-stage timestomping hostile is removed from the batch; no accurate finding or severity is lost. Both embedded managed members and their parent retain identical traits. Five outside-batch reports retain identical findings, including existing hostile transplant/timestamp-context coverage and benign controls. All 16 original PRNG opcode spellings remain detected.
classifier_disagreement: The decoded DLL remains below the calibrated alert grid (level -1, confidence 0), although raw ensemble probability increases from 0.99091446 to 0.9933288. The two other samples retain level 25/confidence 92. No inaccurate hostile rule is restored to conceal this miss.
scan_notes: Initial scans did analyze all requested bytes, but the optional --follow argument also treated the separate word none as another path. Final scans use --follow=none and have no extra path error. Before/after member sets and byte hashes agree; no fetched dependency contributes findings.
